media:content.media:description: To assess where lead dust might have dispersed and how much contamination possibly occurred, academic and EPA scientists have spread out across Iowa to collect samples and begin testing.

media:content.media:description: Local residents complained of poor communication from the Army and insufficient time to prepare, which led officials to delay the detonation.
